newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita Electric to build new plant in Wales.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita Electric to build new plant in Wales.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would build a new plant to produce electronic components in Port Talbot, Wales.
Total spending on the project is expected to be 13 million sterling, the company said in a statement.
Construction of the plant is expected to start next month, with operations due to begin in January 1998, it said.
The plant will be built on land already owned by the company on the Baglan Industrial Estate in Port Talbot, close to Matsushita Electronic Components' (UKCOM) existing facilities.
The plant will produce switching transformers, choke coils and car audio speakers, the statement said.
